description: The file defines the class ProductUtilServices, which contains utility static methods for various product-related operations within the OFBiz platform. These include managing product variants, discarding obsolete products, attaching features to categories, and updating product images.

classes.name: ProductUtilServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for managing product variants, discontinuing products, category memberships, and images in the OFBiz system.

methods.name: discVirtualsWithDiscVariants
methods.description: Expires ProductAssocs for all discontinuing variants and discontinues virtual products with all associate variants expired.

methods.name: removeCategoryMembersOfDiscProducts
methods.description: Removes category memberships for all products that have a sales discontinuation date.

methods.name: removeDuplicateOpenEndedCategoryMembers
methods.description: Removes duplicate ProductCategoryMember entries for the same product and category, keeping only the earliest.

methods.name: makeStandAloneFromSingleVariantVirtuals
methods.description: Converts virtual products with a single variant into standalone products, merging related data.

methods.name: mergeVirtualWithSingleVariant
methods.description: Merges a virtual product with its single variant, updating related entities and optionally removing the virtual.

methods.name: duplicateRelated
methods.description: Copies related entities from a product to its variant, respecting date ranges and duplication constraints.

methods.name: setAllProductImageNames
methods.description: Sets the image URLs for all products based on a specified filename pattern, handling virtual products accordingly.

methods.name: clearAllVirtualProductImageNames
methods.description: Clears all image URL fields for virtual products.

methods.name: attachProductFeaturesToCategory
methods.description: Associates product features with categories and sub-categories, creating feature groups and applications as needed.

methods.name: attachProductFeaturesToCategory
methods.description: Recursive method to attach features to a category and its sub-categories, creating feature groups and applications.
